summary: Build practical calendar, meeting, records, and briefing skills in five days. Explore the executive assistant training course and outline.
lede: Executive assistant training develops practical ways to coordinate leadership schedules, prepare meetings, and manage sensitive information. For current and aspiring executive assistants, administrative coordinators, and office managers, it covers Outlook calendar planning, request prioritization, Teams meeting packs, and executive correspondence. Learners also practise travel and expense tracking, records handling, Excel briefings, and reviewing AI-assisted drafts before sharing.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who coordinate executive schedules, prepare leadership meetings, handle confidential information, or support management reporting. It is designed for foundation-level learners and working professionals who want a more consistent approach to day-to-day executive support.
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: routine experience using email, calendars, and office documents. No programming is required. Exercises use planning templates and scenarios; access to Microsoft 365 applications may help with practice but is not stated as a course-provided resource.
